## Samples used

```{r}
read_output('cca_counts.csv') |>
  transmute(Site = site, Period = period, `Input samples` = input_samples,
    `Used to fit` = calibration_samples, Positioned = positioned_samples) |>
  show_table('cca_counts', caption = '**Plots and samples used to fit and positioned in the CCA.**')
```

## Model

```{r, comment = ''}
cat(readLines(out('cca_model_output.txt')), sep = '\n')
```

```{r}
read_output('cca_climate_contributions.csv') |>
  transmute(Variable = variable, Label = variable_label, `Marginal inertia` = marginal_inertia,
    `Unique % of constrained` = unique_percent_constrained, `Pseudo-F` = pseudo_F,
    `p (unrestricted)` = p_unrestricted, `p (within parks)` = p_within_parks, VIF, CCA1, CCA2) |>
  show_table('cca_climate_contributions', caption = '**Climate variables: marginal tests, inflation and biplot scores.**')
read_output('cca_species_contributions.csv') |>
  transmute(Species = species, `Legacy plots` = legacy_plots, `% of legacy plots` = prevalence_percent,
    `% of constrained inertia` = percent_constrained_inertia, CCA1, CCA2) |>
  show_table('cca_species_contributions', caption = '**Species: share of the constrained inertia and scores.**')
```
